workflow.dispatch_logic: Debate is local to groups until the controller emits representative-only summaries. Inter-group traffic is restricted to representative packets.

nodes.group_dispatch: Fan out the intra-group debate stage.

stopping_criteria: No meaningful change between group or representative revisions
